description: This file defines filter classes for tags within the Superset project, including filters for tag type, tag name, and tag ID, used to filter dashboards, slices, saved queries, and tables based on tags.

classes.name: UserCreatedTagTypeFilter
classes.description: Filter class for selecting user-created or system tags based on the 'custom_tag' argument.

classes.name: BaseTagNameFilter
classes.description: Base filter class for filtering entities (dashboards, slices, queries, tables) by tag name.

classes.name: BaseTagIdFilter
classes.description: Base filter class for filtering entities by tag ID.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the filter to a SQLAlchemy query based on the filter's criteria (tag type, name, or ID).
